This recording was made by lowering a microphone down a deep unused brick waterhole.  The waterhole is about 3 meters diameter and about 12 to 15 meters deep.  There are terraces inside that have become the roosting sites for several dozen Rock Doves. The advantage of this is that the doves are undisturbed by people and there is little street noise for recording.  For the second of two recordings, I lowered the microphone down the center of the waterhold about 7 meters before recording. The first recording is XC796913.
